question: Which of the following is a major risk associated with fuel spillage?
solution:
The correct answer is __Fire hazards and environmental contamination.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Fuel spillage__ poses significant risks to both safety and the environment.
 
• It creates a high fire hazard, especially in areas where flammable substances are present.
 
• Spilled fuel can lead to soil and water contamination, causing long-term environmental damage.
 
• Improper handling or cleaning of spilled fuel can escalate risks and lead to accidents.
 
• Mitigating these risks requires proper training and the use of safety equipment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Fire Hazards:**

 
 
• Fuel spills increase the likelihood of fires, especially in enclosed or poorly ventilated spaces.
 
• Ignition sources such as open flames or sparks can cause severe accidents.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Contamination:**
 
 
• Fuel seeps into soil and water, polluting ecosystems.
 
• It affects marine life, drinking water sources, and agricultural land.
 
 
 
• **Preventive Measures:**
 
 
• Regular maintenance of fuel storage and handling equipment.
 
• Immediate cleanup of spills using absorbent materials.
